title: PlanReviewVerifyInputsOutput
description: OUTPUT of `plan_review_verify_inputs`: the shared plan-bearing prefix and the Pass-2 verifier `instructions` (header + per-finding listing) fed into the workflow's verify prompt step (its `with: {shared_prefix, instructions}`).

shared_prefix.description: prompts.shared_plan_prefix(PlanContext.plan_text) — the byte-identical plan-bearing leading prefix shared with the Pass-1 finder system prompt; resolves the verifier prompt's {{shared_prefix}}.

instructions.description: The Pass-2 verifier instructions as a LIST of per-chunk per-finding listings (global indices preserved). ONE element in the common case (whole request fits the window); token-budgeted splits only when it would exceed the window. The verify prompt step runs once per element and merges verifications by index.
